summary: 1. No new survey file (Day 17, which would reconcile July 11) has landed, and the Distance report and Equipment running hours workbook were not updated this pass. 2. Key operational findings: 1. 3. July 11 total production reached 25,575 BCM against a 23,469.2 BCM target — +9.0% over plan, with ore beating its target by 48% (2,697 BCM vs 1,822.0 BCM), the strongest ore day since July 8. 2. 4. MTD total sits at 351,571 BCM against a 363,773.2 BCM target — −3.4% vs target, narrowing from July 10's −4.2% gap; MTD ore surplus jumped to +3.4% (from July 10's essentially-flat +0.3%), driven entirely by the day's ore beat. 3. 5. MTD crusher stockpile throughput reached 32,752.5 LCM against the 124,000 LCM monthly plan — 26.4% of plan, still well short of a linear day-17-of-30 pace (~57%). 6. The drill rig fleet fell to 70.83% daily availability, the lowest reading of the July run, driven by two faults moving the wrong way on the same day: DR-343's "Faulty Drifter" escalated from a 12-hour night-only stoppage (July 10) to a full 24-hour breakdown, and DR-297 developed a new hydraulic-oil-leak fault that rolled into an overnight drifter breakdown, still open at report time. 7. Drilling missed its target for the first time since July 9 (−18.1%). 8. DT-282 swapped fault root cause rather than recovering — the coolant-sensor problem it had carried since July 7 closed out July 11 at 9:00 AM, but a new transmission-oil-leak fault opened the same day at 11:00 AM and carried through to July 12 — the truck has now been down 5 straight days on two unrelated faults. 9. DT-244's tyre fault, by contrast, genuinely cleared July 11 at 3:00 PM after roughly 48 hours down. EX-123 stayed down a sixth straight day ("L.H Track Off"). Overall fleet daily availability eased to 91.52% (MTD 91.86%), down from July 10's 93.37%, driven mostly by the drill rig fleet. No new INX-SUM survey file has landed for Day 17 — the MTD survey gap headline in [[survey-volume-reconciliation]] still reflects Day 16 (through July 10, +3.53%). Following the KB's established 30-day production-month convention, July 11 is production day 17 of 30 — 13 days remaining. A "Friday prayer break" crusher stoppage appears on the July 11 (Saturday-dated) Client Meeting Report tab — flagged as a possible day-mismatch in the source data, not resolved this pass. Wiki updates: [[daily-production-report]] (Day 17 update section) and [[fleet-availability-utilization]] (July 11 Daily Availability Final Report section) updated; `Last updated` bumped to 2026-07-12 on both; `Wiki/INDEX.md` refreshed for the same two articles. Grade Control workbook not re-checked this pass (block-grid layout issue stands, unchanged since the 45th pass). Distance report and Equipment running hours not updated this pass. Workshop Daily Task 12-Jul-2026.pdf and the Weekly Production Review pptx registered at index level only, out of scope for this task. Full detail in `RAW/_INGESTED.md` under "53rd compile pass."
